speaker: sam_latchet
text: Master Shakespeare. Why does the book tell me to look frightened when I come on? Nobody has told my lady anything yet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Because the realm is already falling, Sam. The king has fallen, and what the gardeners know is already true when you step in. That is the whole play.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Answer from his entrance, Will. He's not read the play. He's read his roll.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From the entrance, then. Thou hast seen thy lady not sleep. That is enough to be frightened of. Thou dost not need the rest of it.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I've seen her not sleep. I can do that. I don't have to know why the rest of them are sad.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You don't. Three lines, Sam. Frightened, and clear, and then you are done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say them as a boy who has been awake in a house. Not as a boy who has been told a plot. A boy of twelve, who has seen his lady walk the night, is frightened enough.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am waiting to go on. I am looking at my shoes. A queen knows only what is in her roll.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou mayst enjoy it a little, Nick. He asked a true question, and I began him at the wrong end.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I would not presume, Master Shakespeare. I have read my roll. I have not read his.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The queen knows what the queen has heard. Nothing more, at this entrance. Sam has given you a boy who is frightened. Use him.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Is her not sleeping in my three lines, or do I only look it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou lookst it. The lines are the three lines. The night is in thy face when thou comest in.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Again, from the door. No realm on thy shoulders.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There. From the door, not the book. I'll put that on the tables before I love the long answer better.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And I shall go on as if I had not been given a lesson. I was given a boy at a door. I am not smiling.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nobody is asking you to smile, Nick. Three lines is the part.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I'll stay by the door. I've seen her not sleep, and that's the whole of what I know.
